design_detail: Calls for a wealth tax of 5% above EUR 5 million in the next tax plan.
quote_original: Denk aan een miljonairsbelasting van 5% boven de 5 miljoen.
quote_en: Consider a millionaire tax of 5% above five million.
source_title: Parliamentary wealth-tax motion or debate
grading_note: Explicit proposed rate and wealth threshold in a Senate debate; not merely criticism of Box 3.

design_detail: 5% on wealth above EUR 5 million.
quote_original: Met deze nieuwe initiatiefwet moeten multimiljonairs 5% belasting gaan betalen op hun vermogen boven de 5 miljoen euro.
quote_en: Under this new private member's bill, multimillionaires must pay 5% tax on their wealth above five million euros.
source_title: SP lanceert nieuwe miljonairsbelasting voor allerrijksten
grading_note: Party launches its own wealth-tax initiative and petition with an explicit rate and threshold.

design_detail: Adopted congress motion PM117.C12 requests a progressive Box 3 stock tax alternative, illustrative 0.5 percentage-point steps up to 2%, with a significant allowance and anti-avoidance via Box 2.
quote_original: een progressieve vermogensbelasting daarentegen wel haalbaar, uitvoerbaar, eenvoudig, uitlegbaar en rechtvaardig is
quote_en: a progressive wealth tax, by contrast, is feasible, implementable, simple, explainable and fair
source_title: PM117.C12 – Rechtvaardige en uitvoerbare vermogensbelasting (aanpassing box-3)
grading_note: Official congress record says Aangenomen and dates the congress 13 May 2023; a formal adopted motion seeking a stock-of-wealth alternative to annual gains taxation.

design_detail: Wealth cap with 100% marginal tax above a democratically determined threshold; manifesto point 41, printed page 23. Frequency unspecified.
quote_original: Er komt een limiet op vermogen, waarboven een marginaal belastingtarief van 100% geldt.
quote_en: There will be a wealth limit above which a marginal tax rate of 100% applies.
source_title: Tweede Kamer Verkiezingsprogramma BIJ1 2025 - Doe eerlijk.
grading_note: Official 2025 election manifesto adopts a wealth cap, included under the project's wealth-cap rule; do not interpret its corporate exit-tax proposal as a personal exit levy.

design_detail: Progressive wealth tax: 1% up to EUR 500,000, rising to 5% above EUR 5 million; increased allowance, amount unspecified. Printed page 58.
quote_original: Er komt een progressieve vermogensbelasting van 1% tot 500.000 euro oplopend tot 5% voor vermogens boven 5 miljoen euro.
quote_en: A progressive wealth tax will be introduced, from 1% up to 500,000 euros, rising to 5% for wealth above five million euros.
source_title: Een wereld te herwinnen: Verkiezingsprogramma Tweede Kamerverkiezingen 22 november 2023
grading_note: Official election manifesto adopts a wealth-stock levy with a rate schedule; this is distinct from its proposals for earnings, inheritance or environmental taxes.

design_detail: Miljonairsbelasting for the wealthiest; the 2025 manifesto does not specify the rate in this passage. Printed page 183.
quote_original: We voeren daarom een miljonairsbelasting in voor de allerrijksten.
quote_en: We will therefore introduce a millionaires' tax for the very wealthiest.
source_title: GroenLinks-PvdA Verkiezingsprogramma 2025
grading_note: Adopted organisational manifesto explicitly promises a millionaires' tax; grade A for formal policy, without inferring an unstated rate.

design_detail: Endorses a 2% stock-of-wealth tax on Dutch Quote-500 fortunes; not an explicit top-up minimum-tax mechanism. Northern regional publication.
quote_original: De Franse econoom Gabriel Zucman heeft een sterk plan, namelijk leg de rijkste mensen een schamele 2 procent vermogensbelasting op.
quote_en: The French economist Gabriel Zucman has a strong plan: impose a mere 2 percent wealth tax on the richest people.
source_title: 25 juni: grote demonstratie FNV tegen afbraakbeleid regering Jetten
grading_note: Official regional FNV publication quotes an FNV official explicitly endorsing a named 2% wealth-tax design; recorded at the regional branch rather than assumed national congress policy.

design_detail: 2–5% wealth tax for the richest 1% of Dutch households, citing the Eerlijke Belastinggids.
quote_original: het instellen van een vermogensbelasting variërend tussen de 2 en 5 procent voor de rijkste 1 procent Nederlandse huishoudens
quote_en: introducing a wealth tax ranging between 2 and 5 percent for the richest 1 percent of Dutch households
source_title: Subsidie voor de hardhebbende Nederlander
grading_note: The network's own editorial recommends a specific stock-of-wealth levy as a correction to the tax system.

design_detail: Permanent progressive wealth tax starting at 2% on wealth above EUR 2.3 million; organisation's own 2025 petition brief. No private petition signers imported.
quote_original: Voer een permanente vermogensbelasting in met oplopende tarieven vanaf 2% op vermogens boven de 2,3 miljoen euro.
quote_en: Introduce a permanent wealth tax with progressive rates starting at 2% on wealth above 2.3 million euros.
source_title: Oxfam Novib petitie Belast de Superrijken
grading_note: Own campaign brief expressly states a permanent wealth-stock tax with threshold and starting rate; 2025 edition year, not an assumed individual signature date.

design_detail: Calls for higher wealth taxation for millionaires; no rate or tax base specified in this 2021 statement.
quote_original: Een hogere vermogensbelasting voor miljonairs.
quote_en: A higher wealth tax for millionaires.
source_title: Wat de Coronacrisis ons ook laat zien
grading_note: Party site explicitly names a millionaires' wealth tax, but this passage gives no design; grade B. Its current undated policy page separately promises a progressive levy above EUR 1 million.
